explanation: The function creates a WP_HTML_Tag_Processor instance and scans for a TITLE tag using next_tag(). Once found, it advances to the next token to retrieve the content. The get_modifiable_text() method automatically decodes character references like — to their corresponding characters. If no TITLE tag exists, it returns null; if the TITLE is empty, it returns an empty string. This approach respects the special handling of TITLE elements as documented: their contents are plaintext with character references decoded.
